mapper.select: select id, from offline_analysis_record order by id desc limit #{offset}, #{limit}
select id,,result_json from offline_analysis_record where id = #{id}
mapper.update: update offline_analysis_record set status = 2, progress = 100, key_count = #{keyCount}, result_json = #{resultJson}, error_msg = null, file_path = '', update_time = now() where id = #{id}
update offline_analysis_record set status = 3, error_msg = #{errorMsg}, file_path = '', update_time = now() where status in (0, 1)
